correctness.rationale: For the stated unit Gaussian the Hermite STFT has squared amplitude e^{-u}u^n/n! and an angular monomial phase up to a common phase, so the radial integral is diagonal; u=π(x²+ξ²) has radial area element du after integrating the angle. The eigenvalues sum to L. The adjacent difference is the lower endpoint minus the upper endpoint of e^{-u}u^{n+1}/(n+1)!; for s>0 it has the sign of L−(n+1)log(1+L/s), and for s=0 it is negative. This gives all maximizers and ties. At a tie, the common endpoint value times (n+1)(1/s−1/(s+L)) gives the claimed slope jump. For m=floor(ρ) and δ=m−s, Stirling gives log of the Poisson density times sqrt(2πs) equal to −[δ/2+(v−δ)^2/2+1/12]/s+O_L(s^{-2}) uniformly on 0≤v≤L because δ is bounded. Averaging this coefficient yields C_L+(δ−(L−1)/2)^2/2. Then δ=L/2−{ρ}+O_L(s^{-1}), also at ties with this choice of mode. The continuous unbounded monotone ρ crosses every phase arbitrarily far out, giving the stated cluster set. The attached verify_annulus.py was inspected, not executed; its finite Simpson checks are corroboration only.
